Job Title: Welder

About the Role
Our client is a leading steel fabricator specializing in large-scale structural projects bridges, mining infrastructure, and commercial buildings. Precision, quality, and safety are at the core of their workshop operations. We are recruiting an experienced Welder to join their team and deliver high-integrity welds on heavy steel sections to exact engineering specifications.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Interpret detailed engineering drawings, blueprints, and welding specification sheets to determine material grades, joint configurations, and correct welding procedures.
• Select, inspect, and prepare metal stock; cut marked-out structural sections using oxy-fuel torches, plasma cutters, and guillotines to precise dimensions.
• Shape and bend steel beams, channels, and pipes using hydraulic presses, bending rolls, and manual heating/hammering techniques to achieve required profiles.
• Align and fit components using clamps, jigs, and measuring tools; join sections via MIG, TIG, flux-cored arc welding, and bolting/riveting methods.
• Examine completed welds for bead width, penetration depth, and dimensional accuracy; perform visual checks and assist with non-destructive testing.
• Finish products by grinding, filing, polishing, and cleaning weld zones; apply protective coatings or acid baths as per project standards.

Requirements
• Minimum two years’ welding experience in structural steel fabrication; relevant trade certificate (or equivalent) and current welding certifications.
• Strong ability to read and interpret technical drawings and welding symbols; thorough knowledge of weld procedures and site safety protocols.
• Capable of welding in all positions on heavy plate and sections; comfortable operating overhead cranes and workshop machinery.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

Apply now 
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience in Welder. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

About the Role
Australasian Stone is seeking a skilled and reliable Stonemason to join our growing team in Mount Waverley. As a premier provider of waterproofing, tiling, and stone masonry services across Melbourne's commercial and civil construction sectors, we take pride in the precision and craftsmanship of everything we deliver. In this role, you will work alongside a team of over 100 dedicated trade professionals, contributing to projects that range from commercial high-rises to civil infrastructure developments.
This is an opportunity to bring your trade skills to a business that values quality, takes its work seriously, and gives its people the projects and support to do their best work.

Key Responsibilities
- Interpret complex blueprints and technical specifications to ensure accurate material planning, site preparation, and project execution.
- Utilize advanced machinery and manual techniques for the precise cutting, shaping, and finishing of stone and masonry components to meet exact project tolerances.
- Construct structural and aesthetic masonry installations, ensuring integrity and adherence to architectural design requirements.
- Apply binding agents and mortars to secure masonry units, maintaining structural alignment, consistent jointing, and required leveling standards.
- Implement moisture-proofing and protective sealing measures to ensure the long-term durability and structural integrity of foundations and surfaces.
- Coordinate the safe setup and dismantling of work platforms and low-level scaffolding in compliance with site safety regulations.
- Perform comprehensive maintenance, repair, and restoration services on existing masonry and stonework installations.
- Deliver specialized masonry services, including intricate design work and custom detailing, as necessitated by specific project scopes.

About You
- Trade-qualified with an AQF Certificate III or IV in stonemasonry, or a related discipline, or a minimum of three years relevant experience in lieu
- Demonstrated hands-on experience laying bricks, blocks, or stonework in a commercial or civil construction environment
- Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality finishes
- Able to read and interpret technical plans and specifications
- Physically fit and capable of performing the demands of the role safely
- Holds, or is eligible to obtain, any required registration or licensing
- A reliable team player with a professional approach to work and safety on site

Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: ICT Project Manager (ANZSCO 135112)

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 per annum plus Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: 217 Margaret St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350

Experience required: Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Our valued client – Itero, based in Perth WA is seeking highly experienced MECHANICAL FITTERS to join their dedicated team of professionals. The ideal candidate must be reliable, results-driven, self-motivated, and committed to positively contribute to the team environment.

Itero is Australia’s leading expert in projects complicated by height and specialists in complex asset remediation and maintenance solutions operating across multiple sectors.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION
The Mechanical Fitter is responsible for delivering safe, high-quality mechanical maintenance, shutdown, project and installation services for Itero Australia's clients across mining, industrial, commercial and infrastructure sectors. The role is based on client sites and supports Itero's commitment to Zero Harm, quality workmanship and exceptional customer service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Key Responsibilities
Carry out planned, preventative and breakdown maintenance
Install, overhaul and commission pumps, gearboxes, conveyors, crushers, valves, pipework and rotating equipment
Complete precision alignment, bearing replacement and mechanical fault finding
Read and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs and OEM manuals
Assist with shutdowns, construction and capital projects
Complete job documentation, maintenance reports and QA records
Provide outstanding client service and represent Itero professionally
Maintain tools, vehicles and company equipment
Assist Rope Access crews where required
Travel to metropolitan, regional and FIFO sites as required

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality
Work in accordance with Itero Australia's Integrated Management System
Comply with WHS legislation, client requirements and company procedures
Complete Take 5s, SWMS, JHAs, permits and isolations before commencing work
Report hazards, incidents and near misses immediately
Participate in toolbox meetings and continuous improvement initiatives
Promote Itero's Zero Harm culture
Qualifications & Licences

Mandatory
Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade (or equivalent)
IRATA Rope Access Level 2/3
Working at Heights
Confined Space Entry
Gas Test Atmospheres
Current Australian Driver's Licence
Construction White Card
Ability to pass medical and drug & alcohol screening

Preferred
High Risk Work Licence (Forklift, EWP, Rigging or Dogging)
First Aid
National Police Clearance (where required by clients)

Skills & Experience
Minimum 3 years’ experience
Experience within mining, industrial maintenance, oil & gas or manufacturing
Strong knowledge of rotating equipment and mechanical systems
Competent with precision measuring equipment and laser alignment
Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Excellent communication and commitment to quality

Core Values
Safety First
Integrity
Teamwork
Quality
Continuous Improvement
Customer Focus

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
About Us

Advanced Group Australia is a leading provider of skilled labour solutions across construction, civil, and industrial sectors. With a strong presence in New South Wales and an ongoing commitment to safety, quality, and workforce development, we work with top-tier clients on major infrastructure and building projects. Our team takes pride in delivering reliable, qualified personnel who keep projects moving and completed to the highest standards.

We are currently seeking an experienced and reliable Sheet Metal Worker to join our growing team.

Role

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, and repairing sheet metal products and structures. This includes working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron for applications in construction, HVAC, and industrial installations. You will collaborate with supervisors, tradespeople, and site managers to deliver precise and safe workmanship that aligns with project specifications.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications for fabrication and installation.
- Measure, cut, bend, and shape sheet metal using hand tools, machines, and cutting equipment.
- Assemble and join sheet metal components using welding, riveting, and fastening techniques.
- Install sheet metal products, such as ductwork, roofing, flashing, panels, and frameworks on construction sites.
- Perform modifications or repairs on existing installations, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards.
- Operate and maintain workshop machinery and tools with care and attention to safety protocols.
- Conduct inspections and quality checks on finished products or installations.
- Comply with all site safety requirements and Advanced Group’s work health and safety (WHS) procedures.

Skills & Qualifications
- AQF Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (Sheet Metal Working) or similar (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in sheet metal fabrication, installation, or maintenance.
- Proficiency in working with a range of sheet metal tools and machinery.
